description: Text-to-SQL platform: traffic, outcomes, latency SLOs, LLM token usage, SQL safety, cache, and vLLM engine health.

panels.title: API
panels.description: Scrape status of the API (up{job="text2sql-api"}).

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: All API requests for the selected modes (5m rate).

panels.title: Success ratio
panels.description: status="ok" over all requests (5m). Alert threshold: failures > 10%.

panels.title: P95 latency
panels.description: End-to-end P95 for the selected modes (5m). Alert: > 4s for 10m.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Redis query-cache hits over all lookups (5m, all modes).

panels.title: In-flight
panels.description: Requests currently being processed by the API.

panels.title: LLM errors (5m)
panels.description: LLM backend errors in the last 5 minutes (all kinds). Alert: > 5 per kind.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: API version and base model (text2sql_build_info).

panels.title: Request rate by mode
panels.description: API requests per second, stacked by generation mode.

panels.title: Request rate by status
panels.description: Requests per second by outcome, ordered by severity: ok, rejected (SQL validator), cannot_answer (model abstained), exec_error, llm_error.

panels.title: Success vs failure ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that succeeded (ok) vs failed (rejected + exec_error + llm_error), 5m. Dashed line: 10% failure alert threshold.

panels.title: Adapter traffic
panels.description: Requests per second by LoRA adapter (base = base model, no adapter). Colors follow the adapter name.

panels.title: P50 latency by mode
panels.description: End-to-end P50 request latency by mode (5m window).

panels.title: P95 latency by mode
panels.description: End-to-end P95 request latency by mode (5m window). Dashed line: 4s alert threshold.

panels.title: P99 latency by mode
panels.description: End-to-end P99 request latency by mode (5m window).

panels.title: Stage latency P95
panels.description: P95 per pipeline stage: retrieval (schema RAG), generation (LLM), validation (sqlglot AST checks), execution (read-only SQLite). All modes.

panels.title: Mean time per stage
panels.description: Average seconds per stage execution, stacked: where a typical request spends its time. All modes.

panels.title: LLM tokens / s by kind
panels.description: Prompt and completion tokens per second reported by the LLM backend.

panels.title: Prompt tokens per request by mode
panels.description: Average LLM prompt tokens per API request (5m). Schema RAG should send fewer tokens than full-schema prompting. Cache hits add 0 tokens; SQL repairs add a second call.

panels.title: LLM errors by kind (per 5m)
panels.description: timeout / connection / http_error from the LLM backend client. Alert: > 5 per kind in 5m.

panels.title: Validation failures by reason (per 5m)
panels.description: Generated SQL rejected by the validator: parse errors, multiple statements, writes, forbidden functions, or tables/columns outside the schema allowlist.

panels.title: Validation failures (time range)
panels.description: Total validation failures per reason over the selected time range.

panels.title: SQL repairs (per 5m)
panels.description: Repair attempts after a validation/execution failure, by outcome.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits over all cache lookups (5m). Dashed line: 10% low-hit-ratio alert threshold.

panels.title: Cache lookups by result
panels.description: Cache lookups per second: hit, miss, error (Redis unreachable).

panels.title: Redis memory
panels.description: Memory used vs the 256 MB maxmemory limit (allkeys-lru evicts beyond it).

panels.title: Redis evictions vs expirations (per 5m)
panels.description: Keys evicted by LRU (memory pressure) vs expired by TTL (T2S_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS).

panels.title: Scheduler: running vs waiting
panels.description: Requests in the running batch vs queued. Dashed line: queue-backlog alert (> 10 waiting for 5m).

defaults.noValue: No data - vLLM not running (profile gpu)

panels.title: KV-cache usage
panels.description: GPU KV-cache blocks in use (1 = 100%). vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc, or vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc on older vLLM versions.

defaults.noValue: No data - vLLM not running (profile gpu)

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: vLLM TTFT (queueing + prefill) P50 and P95, 5m window.

defaults.noValue: No data - vLLM not running (profile gpu)

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Generation (decode) and prompt (prefill) tokens per second processed by vLLM.

defaults.noValue: No data - vLLM not running (profile gpu)
